task_metadata.research_topic: importance-sampling granularity and clipping in LLM online RL (PPO/GRPO/GSPO family)
task_metadata.research_question: What granularity of the importance-sampling ratio (token-level, sequence-level, first-k truncated, CISPO-style, geometric-mean, ...) minimises gradient variance while preserving policy-gradient fidelity, and yields the best math-reasoning accuracy after 250 PPO steps on DeepMath-103K (lv3-5)?
notes: Task mirrors the rigorous_codebase pattern of llm-rl-advantage.
The editable registry entry is verl's @register_policy_loss('custom').
Reference functions in verl core_algos.py: compute_policy_loss_vanilla, compute_policy_loss_gspo, compute_policy_loss_clip_cov, compute_policy_loss_dppo_kl, compute_policy_loss_sapo.

tests.label: deepmath-3bench
tests.notes: Trains Qwen3-1.7B for 250 PPO steps on DeepMath lv3-5, evaluates on GSM8K / MATH-500 / AIME-2024.

baselines.name: token_level
baselines.notes: Vanilla per-token ratio + per-token clip. Control baseline.

baselines.name: sequence_level
baselines.notes: Single scalar ratio per sequence = exp(mean_t(log_prob_new - log_prob_old)), broadcast to all tokens.

baselines.name: first_k_tokens
baselines.notes: Per-token ratio for first 64 tokens; ratio detached for later tokens (reduces variance, small bias).

papers.title: Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms
papers.relevance: Introduces the clipped surrogate objective with per-token importance ratios used as the vanilla PPO baseline.

papers.title: DeepSeekMath: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning in Open Language Models
papers.relevance: Introduces GRPO (group-relative PPO), the advantage estimator used in this task (the policy loss is the variable).

papers.title: Group Sequence Policy Optimization
papers.relevance: Proposes sequence-level importance sampling: one ratio per response, shown to stabilize training on long MoE models. Directly motivates the sequence_level baseline.

papers.title: DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale
papers.relevance: Proposes decoupled high/low clipping and dynamic sampling; motivates truncated / length-aware IS schemes (first_k_tokens baseline).

papers.title: MiniMax-M1: Scaling Test-Time Compute Efficiently with Lightning Attention
papers.relevance: Introduces CISPO: clipped IS with stop-gradient, recovering a REINFORCE-like gradient even on clipped tokens. Reference for alternative IS strategies.
